newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar banks in $28 mln loan to Qatar Shipping.
newsitem.headline: Qatar banks in $28 mln loan to Qatar Shipping.

text.p: Qatar Shipping Co said on Tuesday it signed a seven-year $28.68 million loan with a group of Qatari banks to cover half the cost of two oil tankers.
Qatar National Bank will provide $13.68 million, Doha Bank Ltd $7.0 million, Commercial Bank of Qatar $5.0 million and Al-Ahli Bank of Qatar $3.0 million, a company statement said.

Qatar Shipping Co said the 91,717 tonnes crude oil tanker Jawharat Qatar, previously known as the Eagle Orion, was bought for $30.9 million, and the 41,448 clean oil products tanker Jeewanat Qatar, previously known as Sapphire River, was acquired for $26.4 million.
Both tankers were built in Japan, the statement said.
